name: One input, fair fan-out to every model
looks: A dark code panel holding one shared dataset and prompt sits on the left. Thin coloured lines draw from it out to a column of model-name chips on the right, each arriving in its own colour. Beneath it a short checklist settles: a few green checks for what is kept fair and constant, and one red cross for the single thing never done.
build: fan-out-branch-diagram: bezier lines reveal via strokeDashoffset from the panel to each chip, staggered 0.08-0.12s; the checklist rows fade in beneath after the last line lands.
sound: A soft whoosh per line, a tick on each chip, and a lower tone on the checklist's cross item.
prompt: Make a fairness claim visible: show one shared input branching out as drawn lines to every competitor or recipient under test, each landing in its own colour, then close on a short checklist of what stays constant and the one thing that is never allowed to happen.
